## Validation and handoff

Six screened records were added as development records: PMIDs **27594086, 26579002, 26745462, 15316954, 23148476, and 16345043**. The strategy retrieved all six: **100% relative recall against this development set**. This is not independent validation or absolute sensitivity; no held-out set or prior-review benchmark was available.

The optional small-sample block reduced retrieval from 2,985 to 172 records, but was left out because only six relevant records were found—below the skill’s 15-record threshold for establishing that an AND requirement is safe. None of its 30 sampled excluded records met eligibility.

The internal PRESS-structured critique passed after documenting the harness cutoff. **Human PRESS peer review by an information specialist is still pending before use.**
